# Multifractal_Signatures

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Multifractal analysis of physiological signals (e.g., EEG) to characterize scale-invariant complexity changes associated with ageing and dementia. Provides a non-invasive biomarker for neurological state, enabling neuromorphic systems to process and classify brain dynamics in real-time.
